commit-message.description: Run by the commit-msg hook after the format checks pass: does the message describe the staged change? Advisory only.

fit.instructions: Does the commit message accurately describe what the staged diff changes?

options.accurate: The subject and body describe the main change in the diff, and nothing they claim is missing from it.
options.partial: The message describes part of the diff but leaves out a significant change, or overstates what changed.
options.mismatch: The message describes a different change than the one in the diff.

warn_if.message: The commit message does not seem to describe the staged change; reword it or split the commit.

unmentioned.instructions: The staged diff contains a significant behaviour, API, schema or dependency change that the commit message does not mention.

warn_if.message: The diff seems to contain a significant change the message does not mention.

leftovers.instructions: The added lines include debugging leftovers: temporary print or log statements, commented-out code, disabled or skipped tests, or hard-coded test values in production code.

warn_if.message: The added lines seem to contain debugging leftovers (prints, commented-out code, skipped tests).
